headline: 耳语人与Dark Matter双线领跑，新片剧集齐热
headlineEn: Whisper Man and Dark Matter Lead Across Film and TV
summary: 今日无新片上映但本周有5部新片。电影《耳语人》登顶热度，剧集《Dark Matter》同期霸榜，剧集《成年大朋友》与电影《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》紧随，影视话题持续升温。
summaryEn: No new films opened today, but 5 hit this week. Movie Whisper Man tops the heat, while TV series Dark Matter rules charts; Adult Friend and Spider-Man: Fresh Day follow closely.

industryHighlights.text: 今日0部新片上映，但本周共有5部新电影亮相。
industryHighlights.en: Zero new films today, but 5 new movies debut this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《耳语人》登顶今日电影热度榜。
industryHighlights.en: Whisper Man tops today's movie chart.

industryHighlights.text: 《Dark Matter》同时出现在电影和剧集趋势榜，热度跨类型。
industryHighlights.en: Dark Matter trends across both movie and TV charts.

industryHighlights.text: 剧集《成年大朋友》《鼠惑》今日话题度持续走高。
industryHighlights.en: TV series Adult Friend and Rat Trap keep rising in buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 新片《坠落2：死点》已列入即将上映名单。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming film Fall 2: Dead Point is on the release slate.
